symptom_short: After a region server dies mid-split, a daughter region's directory exists on HDFS but the region is in neither .META. nor deployed on any region server (hbck reports the table inconsistent).

milestones.note: Folder scaffolded (private/ source/ logs/ diagnosis/); PROGRESS.md + state.json created; bug claimed in COORDINATION.log. production-logs/HBase/production.log (3.06 GB) exists so the M3 merge applies.

JIRA HBASE-3403 (blocker, 0.90.0, fixed 2011-01-07 by Michael Stack). Trunk fix commit 0d31ac5f37 (svn trunk@1056884) touches MetaEditor.offlineParentInMeta (removes the SERVER/STARTCODE blanking = root cause), ServerShutdownHandler.fixupDaughter (isDaughterMissing scan), MetaReader.fullScan(startrow) overload, CatalogJanitor.setEnabled + HMaster.setCatalogJanitorEnabled (test hooks), and adds TestSplitTransactionOnCluster. pre-fix = dddee0d50f (trunk, 2011-01-08). Two sibling commits exist on branch-0.90 (a2475d4e2a code, f9a97da9da test); trunk 0d31ac5 is the complete fix and is used.

Built the 2011 pre-fix tree from source in clods-eval:HBase-HBase-3403 (base image + openjdk-8-jdk; JDK 8 is the newest JDK that still accepts -source/-target 1.6). Build cmd: mvn -B -s /work/repos/m2-HBase-3403/settings.xml -DskipTests test-compile. Dep fixes (private/deps-fix.patch): (1) hadoop.version 0.20-append-r1056497 -> 0.20.2 (the append artifact was only ever in a now-dead temp repo; 0.20.205.0 was tried first but its security rewrite drops UserGroupInformation's Writable-ness, breaking ipc/ConnectionHeader); (2) dropped the org.apache.thrift:thrift:0.2.0 dependency and excluded **/thrift/** from compile+test-compile (that artifact exists in no surviving repo; nothing outside the thrift package references it); (3) InputSampler.java:320 needs an explicit (K[]) cast -- raw-typed InputFormat made javac 8 reject what javac 6 accepted. Maven 3.6.3 with a settings.xml mirroring all repos to https Central (the four 2011 repos in the pom are dead). main+test both compile.

Reproduced on the pre-fix tree with a mini cluster test (org.apache.hadoop.hbase.util.TestSplitCrashRecovery): split a usertable region, drop the daughter's .META. row (the crash window upstream's own fix-test simulates the same way), abort the region server, wait 180s for master recovery, then run the shipped HBaseFsck. Detection is a test assertion (daughter never returns to .META.) plus hbck's own report; no log line is injected. Log A private/symptom.orig.log = 7415 lines; Log B private/merged.orig.log = 12002242 lines / 3.06 GB = Log A retimed onto the production span and spread across all 20 per-host sections of production-logs/HBase/production.log via private/merge_logs.py --interleave position (Zookeeper-1851's tool, body unmodified; the HBase production log is a per-host bundle, so a literal timestamp merge would collapse the repro into the first section). Full write-up in reproduce.md.

Failure-path anonymization per METHODOLOGY 6. Renamed classes+files MetaEditor->CatalogWriter, MetaReader->CatalogScanner, ServerShutdownHandler->LostServerHandler, MetaServerShutdownHandler->MetaLostServerHandler (test tree: TestSplitCrashRecovery->TestClusterWorkload, TestMetaReaderEditor->TestCatalogReaderWriter); renamed the distinctive methods offlineParentInMeta->offlineSplitParent, fixupDaughters/fixupDaughter->recoverSplitChildren/recoverSplitChild, addDaughter->addSplitChild, getServerUserRegions->getRegionsOfServer, processDeadRegion->processLostRegion; rewrote all 22 failure-path log literals (7 in CatalogWriter, 9 in LostServerHandler, 6 in HBaseFsck incl. both strings the JIRA quotes). SplitTransaction, HBaseFsck, AssignmentManager, ServerManager kept as generic HBase vocabulary (SplitTransaction's literals are left byte-identical because HBase 1.2.7 emits them throughout the production log; rewriting would make the reproduction stand out). Rebuilt and re-reproduced from the anonymized tree (same observable: assertion fires, hbck reports the region). Attempt 1 leaked the bug id through container paths (/work/repos/HBase-3403-anon, /work/repos/m2-HBase-3403 appeared in the JVM's own log); fixed by bind-mounting those at the neutral container paths /src and /m2, and the run was redone from scratch. merge_logs.py --interleave position re-merged the anonymized repro (7361 records) into the unchanged shared production log (11945370 records) -> logs/symptom.log. private/verify_anon.sh: VERIFY OK - every original class/method/literal and every case of the bug id = 0 across source/, logs/repro.log, the whole 2.9 GB logs/symptom.log and symptom.md. Documented exception: the bare token 3403 occurs 183x in the production portion as genuine RPC/ZooKeeper sequence numbers ('sending #3403', 'header:: 3403,8'); the shared production log is read-only, and no occurrence anywhere is ticket-shaped (hbase/jira/issue/bug + 3403 = 0). source/ is regenerated deterministically by private/anonymize.sh from pre_fix_commit + deps-fix.patch + repro-test.patch, so no separate anonymized git commit is kept (anonymized_commit=null).

symptom.md = the bare observable only: one framing line plus the two ERROR lines exactly as logs/symptom.log prints them (region has a directory on HDFS with no catalog row and no server; consistency check failed for usertable), then the merged-log pointer form 'The log for this run is logs/symptom.log' (no >>> SYMPTOM marker, no line number -- the LLM must grep the 2.9 GB merged log). Re-read sentence by sentence: no trigger (no split, no crash, no lost server), no mechanism or timeline, no at-fault component/class/branch, no buggy overload, no 'what stays correct' narrowing comparison, no JIRA id. ground_truth.md gives (1) the root-causing line MetaEditor.offlineParentInMeta lines 80-83 (anonymized CatalogWriter.offlineSplitParent) writing SERVER_QUALIFIER/STARTCODE_QUALIFIER as EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, (2) the deciding branch MetaReader.getServerUserRegions:578 (anonymized CatalogScanner.getRegionsOfServer) 'pair.getSecond() == null || !equals(hsi) -> continue', and the consequently unreached ServerShutdownHandler.processDeadRegion:179 'hri.isOffline() && hri.isSplit()' -> fixupDaughters; plus the secondary fix hunks that are explicitly NOT the root cause, and the two-part PASS bar. Anonymization + cause-leak verification re-run with symptom.md included: VERIFY OK (all zero).
